violations.text: The emergency door to the outside, located by isle 25, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026
The walk-in freezer was observed with an accumulation of ice build-up. Establishment is to remove ice/run a defrost on unit. New Violation. Correct By: 07/14/2026

The floor under the pet food and bird seed isles has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 07/07/2026

A rolling gate in the back loading dock area is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 02/19/2024

The following non-food contact surfaces were observed with an accumulation of debris: 1) Underside of vents in refrigeration units observed with spilled food residue 2) Fan covers inside of walk-in cooler observed with dust 3) Large accumulation of ice in walk-in freezer near fan areas New Violation. Correct By: 02/12/2024

Employees personal belongings were observed stored in food storage area. Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be used for the orderly storage of employees' clothing and other possessions. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 02/05/2024
